name: Manager - Check for Team, Email Letter for 2025
goal: Manager uses 'Check for team' to request a team member's 2025 appraisal letter via email.
constraints: menuType is 'check for team', isManagerAllowed is 'yes'. User selects 'Check for team', enters Ecode, selects 2025, chooses email. Tool returns 'email successful'.

phases.description: Run setup workflow and confirm menuType is 'check for team' and isManagerAllowed is 'yes'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot presents quick replies: Check for team, 2026, 2025, Others.
Bot presents year quick replies: 2026, 2025, 2024, Others.

phases.description: User selects 'Get the letter via email'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot triggers workflow and returns 'We have triggered the appraisal letter to your email.'

phases.description: Bot asks if user has any other questions.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot message includes 'Do you have any other questions?'

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
